card.name: Often after 'more' in opioid adrenal warning
card.fires_on: The word 'often' in 'more often following greater than one month of use' in the opioid adrenal insufficiency warning. It also fires weakly on small words like 'in' or 'of' in label sentences about how often or how long an effect occurs.

modes.label: more often
modes.description: The word 'often' after 'more' in the adrenal insufficiency sentence about opioid use.
modes.example: Cases of adrenal insufficiency have been reported with opioid use, more<< often>> following greater than one month of use.

modes.label: Linking words in adverse event reports
modes.description: Small words such as 'in' or 'of' in sentences about reported events or event rates.
modes.example: has been reported<< in>> association with drugs that reduce dopaminergic
